hub.title: LINE
hub.intro: Connect a LINE Official Account (Messaging API). Inbound lands in your shared Team Inbox and replies, keyword rules and auto-responders work exactly like every other channel.
hub.loadError: Could not load your LINE channels.
hub.connectBody: Paste the Channel access token and Channel secret from the LINE Developers Console (Messaging API channel).

guide.one: Create a LINE Official Account, then enable the Messaging API on it (this creates the channel).
guide.two: Open the LINE Developers Console → your Messaging API channel.
guide.three: Basic settings → copy the Channel secret.
guide.four: Messaging API → issue and copy a long-lived Channel access token.
guide.five: Paste both here and Connect — we set the webhook for you automatically.

hub.guideNote: The webhook must be public HTTPS. Both values are encrypted at rest and never shown to the browser again.

good.credentials: The channel access token + secret are per-channel — get them in the LINE Developers Console (your Messaging API channel).
good.webhook: The webhook needs a public HTTPS URL — we register it for you automatically on connect.
good.friend: A user must add your LINE account as a friend before you can message them.

connect.savedNeedsAttention: The channel is saved, but LINE did not accept the webhook.
connect.failed: Could not connect the channel. Try again.

channel.rotationHint: Optional. Paste the Assertion Signing Key (RSA private key) and its kid from the LINE console to auto-issue short-lived, revocable tokens. Leave blank to keep the pasted long-lived token.
channel.keySaved: Saved. Paste a new key to replace it.
channel.channelIdPlaceholder: Numeric Channel ID from the LINE console
channel.channelIdHint: Needed once: the signed request names your numeric Channel ID.
channel.rotationEnabled: Token rotation enabled — a fresh v2.1 token was issued and will auto-renew.
channel.rotationDisabled: Token rotation disabled — using the long-lived token.
channel.removeConfirm: Remove this LINE channel? Its inbox threads stay, but it stops sending and receiving, and its broadcasts are deleted.
channel.failed: That did not work. Try again.

broadcasts.title: LINE
broadcasts.intro: Message everyone who has added and chatted with your LINE account, then track sent, failed and blocked per broadcast.
broadcasts.failed: That did not work. Try again.
broadcasts.paused: Paused. The remaining recipients are still queued.
broadcasts.retried: {count, plural, one {# failed recipient is} other {# failed recipients are}} ready to send again. Press Start.
